steps.content: You enter the interrogation room carrying a thick folder filled with every scrap of information you could find about the Ark.
Ark fixes her gaze on you, her eyes like a wounded beast.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: I swear, if you dare harm a single one of them...

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: I'll reduce this whole place to rubble, even if I have to go down with you!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I give you my word: your crew will remain perfectly safe, as long as they don't initiate any conflicts.
Ark lets out a cold snort.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Why should I believe you?

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: You held my crew member to threaten me, and now you're telling me you'll protect them? Do you take me for a complete idiot?!

Sighing, you take out your device, and call the FAC unit in WhiteSands. The interrogation room suddenly fills with a commotion. You turn the screen toward her, on which the crew of the Ark are standing by the gunwale, hurling insults at the FAC soldiers.
Ark freezes in surprise, then tries to snatch the device from your hand, but you swiftly slip it back into your pocket.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: See? They're doing fine.
Ark's shoulders relax slightly, but a trace of indignation still lingers on her face as she eyes you suspiciously.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You'll be reunited with them soon enough. I just need to get some information from you first.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Ark is actually a DisCity warship from the Outland War era. Although this model has long been decommissioned, it still remains DisCity public property.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not only have you taken possession of the Ark, but according to reports from other sand ships, you frequently use it to attack...
Ark's fist slams down hard on the armrest of her chair, cutting you off.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Attack other sand ships?! Those despicable vultures are the ones trying to steal the Ark for themselves, just like you!

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: And taking possession of public property? That's nonsense! The Ark is my home, where I was born and raised...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So this ship had been drifting in WhiteSands before you were born. Who was the ship's original captain, then?
The moment you ask this question, Ark immediately bites her lip and lowers her head, avoiding your gaze.
You both face each other in tense silence for a moment. Finally, you sigh and open your folder.
test
test
test
test
test
test

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Alisa and Rudolf were once senior researchers at DisCorps's research institute. They led the design and construction of the DXVI-type cruiser. They were considered DisCity's most brilliant engineers—until they defected.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Records from the institute show they were last seen at the DisCorps shipyard. That same year, the prototype of the DXVI cruiser also disappeared.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And this missing warship, our investigation confirms, is the Ark.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do these two names sound familiar to you?

As your words hang in the air, the atmosphere in the interrogation room turns suffocating. Ark doesn't look at you. The silence stretches so long that you begin to wonder if she even understood your question.
Suddenly, she begins shaking her head, over and over, then speaks in almost stubborn denial.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: No, no... The Ark is our home...

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: The Ark is no warship...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I understand. You all feel deeply connected to the Ark.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But life in WhiteSands is relentless. Sandstorms, desert bandits, and what you probably hate most, annoying Disians like us...

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: I don't hate Disians.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Right. Samuel mentioned that to me. You can be considered a Disian yourself, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Haven't you ever thought about returning to DisCity?

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: You and Samuel are in cahoots, aren't you? You bribed him with the promise of returning to DisCity.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How did you figure that out?

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Samuel is our best fighter. I've faced you in combat before. There's no way you could have subdued him.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yet despite knowing this, you still agreed to come with me for his sake.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: What else could I have done? Let you slit his throat?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I wouldn't have done that. I never intended to harm any of your crew members.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But now that you know he colluded with me, aren't you angry with him?
Both her tone and her gaze finally begin to soften.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: He's been on this ship for so long. I know he just wanted a peaceful life when he first joined us. If he wants to return to his roots, to go back to DisCity... then so be it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What about you?

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: My parents died in WhiteSands long ago. DisCity means nothing to me.
Her voice sounds distant, yet carries a hint of wistfulness.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Those two people you mentioned... they were my parents.
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Rudolf
steps.content: Hey! Ark, careful, don't touch that!
In the bridge, the man swiftly scooped Ark up as she reached for the control panel.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: But you and Mom both said I'm the captain of the Ark!

steps.speaker: Rudolf
steps.content: When you grow up! Once you're older, you can truly become the captain and lead rescue missions in our place.
Ahead, the figures on the shore grew clearer.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Dad, can I go ashore with you later? Those people sounded so helpless on the radio just now. I want to come help them too.

steps.speaker: Rudolf
steps.content: Sure thing, our little captain. But the sun is about to set, so you'll need to bundle up. Where's that hat Granny Savana knitted for you?

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: This hat's too big. Granny said she'll have to readjust it.
Bursting into laughter, the man shook out the wrinkled hat Ark just pulled from her pocket, and plopped it on her head crookedly.
The hat slides down, covering one of her eyes. Ark giggles.
[Scene Change + Screen Shakes]

Granny Savana had once told her that at her future coming-of-age ceremony, she would personally paint beautiful patterns on Ark's face. After that, Ark would be recognized as a true and proud child of WhiteSands.

She clutched the elderly woman's ice-cold hand, its fingertips having just traced beneath her eye, the fresh crimson perfectly covering her wound. It felt almost like the coming-of-age ceremony she had longed for, if only she could ignore the metallic scent of blood.
The very people they had come to rescue were now patrolling the sand ship that didn't belong to them with arms in their hands.
A pair of feet stopped in front of her. She looked up in confusion. A strange man was staring down at her, axe in hand.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: You've got it all wrong... We came to rescue you, to save you...
The man didn't even bother with the axe. He simply kicked her aside. As she fell to the ground, she found herself staring into her father's lifeless eyes.
In the next instant, her mother rushed over and wrapped her in a tight embrace.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Didn't we come to rescue them? What did we do wrong? Why...

steps.speaker: Alisa
steps.content: We did nothing wrong. We came to save people, and that's never a wrong thing to do, it's just...

steps.speaker: Alisa
steps.content: Ahhh!!!

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Mom?... Mom... Mom!
Her heart ached unbearably, as if burning along with the flames before her. The deck rumbled beneath her feet, groaning mournfully.

steps.speaker: Burly Bandit
steps.content: Is she the one crying?

steps.speaker: Gaunt Bandit
steps.content: Yeah. Let's finish her off and be done with it.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: ...I want you all dead.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: You ungrateful bastards...

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: I want all of you dead!!!
[Screen Shakes + Black Screen Transition]
A hand rested on her shoulder. She trembled slightly.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Samuel, tell me, am I a true and proud child of WhiteSands now?
Samuel turned his head, looking at the bodies scattered across the deck. After a long silence, he finally spoke in a low voice.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: ...Look what the ship has become. Perhaps it's time we find a place to settle down for good.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: No... no. We can't stop yet... The Ark can't stop yet.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: My parents' wish... they can no longer fulfill it themselves...
Blood had dried on her face. She slowly rose to her feet.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Then I'll do it for them!
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: The Ark... the Ark isn't a warship. Mom and Dad weren't traitors either... All they wanted... was just to save people...
Ark's chest heaves. She clenches her teeth tightly, her eyes glistening.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Call me a brute or thug. Say whatever you want. The fact is, when it comes to protecting the Ark and everyone on board, you're right, there's nothing I won't do!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I remember. I remember how fiercely you fought to protect them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That crew member's name was Aisha, wasn't it?
Ark's body stiffens at the mention of the name, her pupils quivering slightly.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: You heard how those bastards killed Aisha... Do you still think what I did was wrong?
Her lips tremble uncontrollably, her voice somewhat indignant.
You shake your head.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: At the time, I wasn't thinking about what was right or wrong. I only thought: This radio station helped me survive the storm, so I wanted them to live on too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What I wished for even more was that they could protect what they cherished and find the peace they truly longed for.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not fighting a lonely, perpetual battle, always covered in wounds.
Your eyes fall on the scars hidden beneath the face paint on Ark's cheeks, then slowly move upward to meet her gaze.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So I'd like to propose a different solution, one that can bring peace without using violence. I will offer permanent sanctuary in DisCity to every crew member of the Ark.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: And what are you asking... in return?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In return, I ask that the Ark continue its original mission. I want you to keep on leading it to help others in need.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And I will provide you with a shipyard.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Because I was once rescued by the Ark myself. In my heart, it's never been a warship.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know that from its creation, it was never designed for warfare.

You pull a sheet of paper from your file and hand it to her. It's the original blueprint for the DXVI model. In this initial design, where cannons now sit, there are only row after row of rescue ladders.
Ark looks down, her fingers tracing over the familiar handwriting on the paper. The same hands once taught her to read, write, and protect others. She lets out a soft laugh.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, will you give me a chance? ...Captain.
Her shoulders shift slightly, as if she's about to reach out her hand.
[Blank Screen + Alarm]
Hurried footsteps approach from a distance. The interrogation room door swings open, and you immediately stand up.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the Ark has just broken through the FAC fleet's blockade and is about to charge into DisCity.
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: This is your final warning! Stop immediately! Or suffer the consequences!
On WhiteSands, the Ark advances toward DisCity with a line of FAC vessels trailing it.
At the stern of the Ark, an elderly man is vehemently hurling insults at the FAC ships.

steps.speaker: Amir
steps.content: Give Ark back, or get the hell out of our way!

steps.speaker: Abu
steps.content: The cannons... won't heat up. What do we do...
Hearing this, the old man bends down and tosses his wooden prosthetic at Abu.

steps.speaker: Amir
steps.content: You useless fool! When have you ever done anything right?!

steps.speaker: Abu
steps.content: Don't... don't be angry, sir. Here, your leg...
As your boat draws closer, the arguing voices become increasingly clear.
On the deck of the Ark, crew members anxiously watch your approach. When you are close enough for them to make out your faces, their eyes suddenly widen in shock.

steps.speaker: Amir
steps.content: ...Ark?! Finally... Finally!
Without a moment's hesitation, they leap onto your boat one after another, rushing toward you. Their sudden boarding causes your small vessel to rock unstably.
Someone lunges forward with an outstretched hand, nearly grabbing Ark, but FAC soldiers quickly step between them.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Step back!
In the midst of the chaos, a familiar tall figure pushes to the front of the crowd, raising both hands in an attempt to calm everyone's anger.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: For our safety, let's not resist them...

steps.speaker: Amir
steps.content: Oh shut it!
The old man punches Samuel square in the face. Samuel staggers several steps backward, clutching his bleeding lip.
He shakes the blood off his knuckles, then pulls a handgun from his waist.

steps.speaker: Amir
steps.content: I'll show them what this old man can do!
The next second, Amir chambers a round. The soldiers immediately lunge to seize the gun. In the ensuing chaos, the barrel swings toward the crowd.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: ****, watch where you're pointing that gun! No!!!
[Blank Screen + Gunshot Sound Effect]

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Chief!
For a second, your entire left arm feels numb, then intense pain hits you. Looking down at the wound, you see bright red blood rapidly soaking through your sleeve.
The crew member you shielded instinctively pushes you away, then stares in horror at the blood. He reaches out hesitantly, unsure whether he should touch you.
You struggle to your feet, swaying unsteadily. Scorching blood streams down your arm, turning thick and cold by the time it reaches your fingertips.
But at least that's quieted them down.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know you've been fighting thieves and bandits throughout your journey. I know you've lost loved ones along the way... I've heard your stories myself.
Your vision blurs, but you take a deep breath, force yourself to stand straighter, and continue speaking in a more confident and sincere tone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I didn't come here to take anything away from you or destroy your home.

Some crew members furrow their brows while others slowly lower their heads. You scan the faces on deck, finally resting your gaze on Ark, who stands at a distance with a conflicted expression. Your tone softens slightly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've come here to make you a promise: DisCity will grant you permanent protection.
As you speak, your eyes drift to your blood-soaked left arm.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even though I was nearly torn to pieces back when I first set foot on the Ark...
Someone on deck shifts slightly, and the tense atmosphere begins to loosen a bit.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But the Ark did offer me the help I needed. That's why I won't take the ship away. On the contrary, I want it to continue sailing the WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...If only for my own sake, as someone who once received your help.
Suddenly, your vision goes black and you collapse forward uncontrollably. The young crew member you saved earlier steps forward and catches you with both hands.

steps.speaker: Young Crew Member
steps.content: Stop talking for now...
The remaining crew members exchange uncertain glances, suddenly unsure how to respond to this situation.
Silence blankets the deck, broken only by the soft patter of dry wind against the hull.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I hope... you'll consider my proposal.
Just as your words fade, a thunderous boom erupts nearby.
[Blank Screen + Sound Effect]

steps.speaker: Abu
steps.content: R-r-ready to fire!!!

steps.speaker: Amir
steps.content: ****! Hold on! Don't fire!
He drops his gun, rushes to the bow, and frantically waves both arms at the Ark.

steps.speaker: Amir
steps.content: For ****'s sake! Stop firing! Stop it!
The cannon barrel seems to be breathing slowly, and you can almost feel its temperature rising.
[Blank Screen + Footsteps]
You sense Ark's presence behind you.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Don't be afraid.
She moves past you, her slender frame now standing in front of you. She doesn't look at you, her gaze fixed steadily on the Ark.
She raises her arm toward the Ark, extending her hand with slightly trembling fingertips, as if bearing some immense, invisible pressure.
Hot air rushes this way, blowing back her sleeves and turning her exposed skin red.
But she doesn't stop, simply pushing her hand forward another inch, defying the scorching heat of the cannon barrel.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: She just...

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: ...needs a little more time to remember.
The cannon muzzle pointing directly at you finally begins to slow down. The machinery emits noises of friction as the rotating parts pause momentarily.
She turns her palm downward, patting rhythmically as if soothing a small beast. The sand ship before you obediently submits to Ark's touch, gradually slowing to a halt and gently lowering itself.
Silence reigns again. Only the sound of the wind remains.
Ark gazes at it with soft eyes.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: This is how she's supposed to be. When I first saw her on shore, she was just like this.

Many years ago, when she was still small enough to ride on her father's shoulders, she stepped onto land for the first time. Turning back, she saw the ship where she was born and raised for the first time.
She had no idea that in the distant DisCity, they called her the Scythe, because her razor-sharp bow had harvested countless enemy lives.
Each of these individual lives became merely a part of an enormous figure, ultimately simplified as a glorious achievement in history.
But all she saw was the Ark outlined in gold by the setting sun. Her family and friends leaned against the railings, waving to them from the deck.

steps.speaker: Voice in the Memory
steps.content: I'm going to sail this ship and rescue lots and lots of people, bringing everyone safely aboard our ship.

steps.speaker: Voice in the Memory
steps.content: I'll make sure everyone in WhiteSands knows they can come to us whenever they're in trouble!
Her eyes shine bright, and her tone is firm.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: The Ark has never ever been a warship.
Metal clanks and hits the deck. The crew wordlessly lower their weapons, watching as their captain walks slowly toward you.
She lifts her head and stands tall, extending her hands to you. These same hands have both helped you up and fought against you in the past.
But now, they want to hold yours.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: As captain of the Ark, I accept your proposal on behalf of my crew.
Your hands clasp together. The sun shines over your shoulders, casting shadows before you.
[Scene Change]
Ark's slender fingers work the bandage deftly, carefully wrapping it around your wound. When she applies pressure, a sharp pain makes you wince and draw in a quick breath.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Did I press too hard? Just bear with it for a moment.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: It's the only way to help it heal faster.
She coos, like she's comforting a child. You watch her concentrated profile as bright sunlight streams through the porthole, illuminating her youthful face. You can't help but smile.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes, Captain.
Abu rushes in frantically with a copper bowl in his hands, spilling some of the broth onto the floor.

steps.speaker: Abu
steps.content: Grub's up! Watch out, it's pipin' hot!
When you finally make out what's in the bowl, you press your hand to your forehead and sigh miserably.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I was just freed from the cage...
Glimpsing your face, Ark laughs brightly.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Just close your eyes, and it'll taste no different than chicken soup! Zulu Zulu!
